setup.baseUrl: settings.json language_models.openai_compatible.<provider-name>.api_url: include /v1, e.g. http://localhost:8787/v1 (Zed appends /chat/completions, so omitting /v1 gives /chat/completions). No trailing slash (a trailing slash would produce //chat/completions).
setup.model: language_models.openai_compatible.<provider-name>.available_models[]: {name: 'agent/sample', display_name, max_tokens: <context window>, max_output_tokens?, max_completion_tokens?, reasoning_effort?, capabilities:{tools, images, parallel_tool_calls, prompt_cache_key, chat_completions, interleaved_reasoning, max_tokens_parameter}}. Models are listed manually: Zed never calls GET /models for this provider.
setup.apiKey: Agent Settings > Add Provider (stored in the OS keychain) or env var <PROVIDER_NAME>_API_KEY (upper snake case, e.g. MY_PROVIDER_API_KEY). A key is mandatory in Zed (it errors with NoApiKey otherwise); sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
setup.notes: JSON: {"language_models":{"openai_compatible":{"oaa":{"api_url":"http://localhost:8787/v1","available_models":[{"name":"agent/sample","max_tokens":128000}]}}}}. Requests are issued directly from the Zed process (reqwest), so a localhost gateway is reachable. Set capabilities.chat_completions:false only for Responses-API-only models. An optional `custom_headers` map adds headers.

cases.title: Zed: streaming chat without tools (text threads, thread summaries, git commit message, inline-assistant style requests)

evidence.note: Body keys verified from into_open_ai + the serde skip rules on open_ai::Request: stream is always present, stream_options {include_usage:true} when streaming, temperature is ALWAYS sent (request.temperature or 1.0), while max_completion_tokens/max_tokens, stop, tools, tool_choice, parallel_tool_calls, prompt_cache_key, reasoning_effort and service_tier are omitted unless set. A message with a single text part serializes as a plain string.

messages.content: You are a highly capable coding assistant. (illustrative; Zed's real system prompt is long)

cases.notes: Headers (chat_completion_request, open_ai.rs L1216-L1241): Content-Type: application/json, Authorization: Bearer <key trimmed>, plus the user's `custom_headers`; the shared reqwest client adds User-Agent 'Zed/<version> (<os>; <arch>)' (main.rs L512-L522). No Accept header, no x-stainless-*, no HTTP-Referer/X-Title. Stream parsing (language_model_core chat_completion.rs): each `data:` line must be JSON with a `choices` or `usage` key (else 'unrecognized chat completion stream chunk' error); `choices` may be missing/null/empty; delta.role is not read; delta.content may be a string or an array of parts; finish_reason is read ('stop'->EndTurn, 'tool_calls' flushes accumulated tool calls, 'length'->MaxTokens, 'content_filter'->refusal, unknown values logged and treated as EndTurn); `usage` is read when both prompt_tokens and completion_tokens are present. A non-null top-level `error` object fails the stream. `data: [DONE]` ends the stream, but EOF without [DONE] is also accepted. The system role is sent as role 'system' (never 'developer'). Whitespace-only user text parts are dropped. Special cases in into_open_ai: an agent name starting with 'o1-' is sent with stream:false and no stream_options; temperature is dropped for a few gpt-6 model ids (completion.rs L45-L57). Zed requires an API key to be configured (placeholder key if the gateway does not need one) - otherwise it fails with NoApiKey before sending anything.

cases.notes: Tool name/description/schema are illustrative. Wrapper verified: {type:'function', function:{name, description, parameters}} - no `strict` field exists in Zed's FunctionDefinition. Tool-call deltas are accumulated by `index`; tool arguments are JSON-parsed on finish_reason 'tool_calls' (a parse failure becomes a ToolUseJsonParseError, not a crash). A tool_call delta with index -1/null or function null is tolerated (unit tests in chat_completion.rs L757-L810).

cases.title: Zed: streaming with every optional per-model setting enabled (max_output_tokens, parallel_tool_calls, prompt_cache_key, reasoning_effort, tool_choice)

cases.title: Zed: user message with several text parts becomes a content ARRAY of text parts

evidence.note: MessageContent::push_part converts a Plain string into Multipart([Text, new]) when a second part is added, and From<Vec<MessagePart>> collapses a single text part back to a string. That real Agent user turns contain several consecutive text parts (e.g. mentions/context blocks followed by the prompt) is inferred, not observed.

cases.notes: Zed can also serialize `content: []` (an empty Multipart) for a message that ended up with no parts, since MessageContent::empty() is Multipart(vec![]); not expected in normal flows.

cases.title: Zed: follow-up turn after a tool call (assistant content null + tool_calls, then tool message)

evidence.note: A ToolUse content item creates {role:'assistant', content: None, tool_calls:[...]} -> serialized as `"content": null` (the field has no skip_serializing_if). If the same assistant turn also had text, the tool calls are appended to that message and content is the text. Tool results serialize as {role:'tool', content, tool_call_id}; content is a plain string for one text part and an array of parts if several (or an image).

cases.title: Zed: user message with an inline image (only when capabilities.images is true)

evidence.note: Image becomes {type:'image_url', image_url:{url:'data:<mime>;base64,...'}} with `detail` omitted. Images are attached only when the model's capabilities.images is true (default false), otherwise Zed does not offer image input for that model.

cases.notes: Image input (docs/images.md): the data-URL image is decoded, checked and stored as an input file of the caller, and reaches an image-capable agent (the lab fixture agent declares image input) in its provider's own image shape. A text-only agent answers 400 unsupported_content with error.param on this part instead.

cases.notes: OUT OF SCOPE for a chat-completions-only gateway: needs POST /v1/completions. Skip if not served. Unlike language_models.openai_compatible.api_url (which excludes /chat/completions), edit_predictions.open_ai_compatible_api.api_url must be the FULL URL including /v1/completions.
